node.title: Rank-eleven fixed 31-anchor star routes to C/S/A/E
node.closure: one line-global core decision, deviation-basis anchor deck, order-32 star coverage, and 31-overlap certificate coherence
node.statement: For every unsafe deployed KoalaBear post-near error-rank-eleven line, intersect the maximal supports of the complete selected family once. Non-affinity forces this global core below K. If it is nonempty, the whole family enters one identity-fiber shortened residual C. If it is empty, choose eighteen records on the dense minimizing pair and 1..10 actual records whose deviations from that pair line form a basis; fillers give 31 fixed anchors whose maximal supports have empty intersection. Adjoining any other record gives a deployed-domain non-affine order-32 tuple of slope degree 18..31. All tuples share identical explanations and support locators, so collision rigidity makes primitive root-free rational certificates projectively identical and any failure a named exception. Thus the zero-core family routes to primitive spread S, one coherent rational atom owner A, or exception routing E. The disjoint near charge is 134944. No C/S/A/E payment is claimed.
